entries.name: zouroboros
entries.reason: Umbrella rewritten for Hermes: skills/zouroboros/zouroboros is the index, read-only doctor (integration/cli.ts doctor + governance verify-docs + skill tree) and exact-phrase operator shortcuts resolved by zouroboros-core resolveOperatorShortcut against distribution commands; install.ts replaced by scripts/setup.sh + integration/cli.ts init. Nested sub-skills: workflow/unstuck-lateral shipped as skills/zouroboros/unstuck-lateral (MIT, Q00/ouroboros); assets/template.program.md shipped as autoloop/templates/program.md (units fixed); workflow/autoloop and three-stage-eval are covered by the autoloop and three-stage-eval entries; skills/memory (41 host scripts) and skills/swarm (host bridges, persona registry, benchmarks, MCP servers) are covered by zo-memory-system, zo-swarm-orchestrator and zo-swarm-executors; skills/selfheal SKILL-introspect/prescribe/evolve duplicate the zouroboros-introspect/-prescribe/-evolve entries (t5); spec-first-interview has its own entry. Not shipped: skill-tracker.ts (writes the host shared memory DB), scripts/package.json, swarm references/images and persona registry.

entries.name: zouroboros-governance
entries.reason: Wired to distribution paths: canonical ZOUROBOROS.md and CONSTITUTION.md ship in references/ (verbatim copies of the workspace-root documents) and verify-docs checks them by default (ZOUROBOROS_GOVERNANCE_DOCS_DIR / optional mirror). Preflight gate (Articles I-X) unchanged; promotion phase fails closed (IX-PROMOTION-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE) because the persona-attestation/operator-approval/provider-native issuer/authorization-ledger stack is host authority, not distributed. Hash-chained anchored audit log and approval registry under ZOUROBOROS_STATE_DIR/ZOUROBOROS_CONFIG_DIR; BLOCKED_TOOLS uses Hermes tool names; offline operator authorization guards the agent host; capability-ethics scans the distribution skills tree. Not shipped: promotion issuer/attestation/approval/ledger scripts, autonomy classifier and pre-tool adapter, managed Codex guard installer and wrapper, destructive-command policy and quarantine, delegation receipts, dissent digest (Zo email, retired consensus gate), restore drill, ZOU-488 worker, config/ (host runtime adapters, Codex requirements).
entries.followUp: Destructive-command policy + quarantine could become a Hermes pre-tool hook; promotion authority would need an operator-provisioned issuer.

entries.name: zouroboros-introspect
entries.reason: Thin Hermes skill over packages/selfheal introspect() (integration/selfheal.ts): memory read through the distribution memory layer (profile memory.db enforced; inherited ZO_MEMORY_DB/ZOUROBOROS_MEMORY_DB overridden; schema initialised), scorecards under ZOUROBOROS_STATE_DIR/selfheal, logs under ZOUROBOROS_LOG_DIR. packages/selfheal paths made configurable (src/paths.ts) and its --store fact write fixed for the memory schema. Not shipped: source introspect.ts and skill-tracker.ts (Zo shared-facts schema via sqlite3 CLI; superseded by the package collector), references/metric-thresholds.md (describes the superseded 6-metric script).

entries.name: zouroboros-memory-evolution
entries.reason: Reclassified on re-verification: a Phase-0 baseline experiment over this host's live memory. evalsets/memory-baseline.v1.jsonl is NOT synthetic: apart from the 4+ adversarial probes it is derived from live operator facts (real fact ids, the operator's handle, BYOK model ids, personal preferences and project state) and must never ship. The harness reads the host memory DB, persona files and memory gate, and canary.ts plants rows into the live DB.
entries.followUp: Parity concept: a distribution memory-retrieval eval over packages/memory with a newly authored synthetic eval set.
